title: Rosslare Europort
summary: Engineering services at Ireland's gateway port to Europe.
body:
AOCA undertook a number of audit inspections of the ongoing construction of the many buildings on the new Europort for John Paul Construction. This is part of their continuous quality control improvement process where the best in business from an auditing perspective asked to review the construction works and advise on best practice or improvements to their approach.
The inspections lasted the duration of the project and was a beneficial process for John Paul Construction. AOCA are now involved in similar auditing roles for multiple site for John Paul Construction.
